{%- comment -%} FAQ accordion + FAQPage JSON-LD -- AEO sprint, Week 2 Day 1. Self-filters to 7 specific PDPs by handle; renders nothing on any other product. Every answer is sourced from copy already live elsewhere on this site (see PR notes for exact sources) -- nothing here is newly invented marketing copy. Visible text and JSON-LD text are generated from the same assigned variables so they always match word for word. {%- endcomment -%} {%- liquid assign faq_handles = 'eclat-14k-gold-vermeil-necklace,the-cobalt-edition-necklace,miro-spanish-dancer-earrings,miro-blue-necklace,miro-femme-et-oiseaux-golden-necklace,bauhaus-purple-red-earrings,architect-enamel-copper-earrings' | split: ',' assign faq_show = false for h in faq_handles if product.handle == h assign faq_show = true endif endfor -%} {%- if faq_show -%} {%- liquid assign faq_is_miro = false if product.title contains 'Miró' or product.title contains 'Miro' assign faq_is_miro = true endif assign faq_material = '' assign faq_material_field = product.metafields.general.materials if faq_material_field.type == 'metaobject_reference' assign faq_mo = faq_material_field.value assign faq_material = faq_mo.fields.display_name.value | default: faq_mo.fields.name.value | default: faq_mo.fields.title.value elsif faq_material_field.type == 'list.metaobject_reference' assign faq_material_list = '' for faq_mo in faq_material_field.value assign faq_mo_name = faq_mo.fields.display_name.value | default: faq_mo.fields.name.value | default: faq_mo.fields.title.value if faq_mo_name != blank assign faq_material_list = faq_material_list | append: faq_mo_name unless forloop.last assign faq_material_list = faq_material_list | append: ', ' endunless endif endfor assign faq_material = faq_material_list else assign faq_material = faq_material_field.value endif if faq_material == blank assign faq_material_slug = product.metafields['shopify']['jewelry-material'].value if faq_material_slug != blank assign faq_material_words = faq_material_slug | replace: '-', ' ' | split: ' ' assign faq_material = '' for word in faq_material_words assign faq_material_word = word | capitalize assign faq_material = faq_material | append: faq_material_word | append: ' ' endfor assign faq_material = faq_material | strip endif endif assign faq_q1 = 'Is this an officially licensed Miró piece?' assign faq_a1 = 'Yes. This piece is part of the official Miró Collection, licensed by Successió Miró, and crafted in Spain by Joidart.' assign faq_q2 = 'What is ' | append: product.title | append: ' made from?' assign faq_a2 = product.title | append: ' is made from ' | append: faq_material | append: '.' assign faq_q3 = 'How do I care for this piece?' assign faq_a3 = 'An Atelier Modernista polishing cloth is enclosed with your purchase to help maintain your jewellery. Please limit exposure to water, fragrance, cosmetics, and chemicals, and remove the piece before showers, swimming, or exercise.' assign faq_q4 = 'What is your returns policy?' assign faq_a4 = '30-day returns are included with your purchase for most Atelier Modernista items, but please note that, in order to uphold the highest standards of hygiene and safety, pierced earrings are non-returnable. Luxury Gift Wrapping is also non-returnable.' assign faq_q5 = 'How much does UK shipping cost, and how long does delivery take?' assign faq_a5 = 'Orders dispatch within 1-2 days. Standard UK delivery costs £3.95, or is free for Atelier Circle members, and arrives within 1-4 days of dispatch. Express UK delivery is available for £7.95.' -%}

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: An Atelier Modernista polishing cloth is enclosed with your purchase to help maintain your AM jewellery. Each piece is delicately crafted, so please limit exposure to water, fragrance, cosmetics, and chemicals. Remove before showers, swimming, or exercise.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: 30-day returns are included with your purchase for most Atelier Modernista items, but please note that, in order to uphold the highest standards of hygiene and safety, pierced earrings are non-returnable. Luxury Gift Wrapping is also non-returnable.
